description: The University of Klagenfurt C3 team publishes execution and network traces from an edge-computing testbed. The free Zenodo ZIP is licensed CC BY 4.0 and documents five CSV tables collected from 24 October to 9 November 2022. They describe throughput with message sizes, round-trip latency statistics and execution times for video encoding, framing, training and inference on workstation and small-board devices. These observations can calibrate scheduling and communication delays in edge-cloud simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this measurement series. Coverage is the stated testbed and applications, not all deployment workloads. A bandwidth value of minus one denotes a refused connection, not negative throughput. Some CPU descriptions and destination labels in the documentation require reconciliation before hardware comparisons. Missing samples, background load and clock accuracy remain uncertain. No traces were downloaded or workflow scheduler executed.
name: Edge infrastructure traces
